selection_rule: smallest observed matched-state failure count; tie chooses larger cadence r (lower EC time)
sampler: uniform random six logical Pauli eigenstate/matched-measurement settings; independent52bit coin; fixed floor-CDF probabilities
learner_inputs: raw per-policy selection counts, policy list and declared clock costs only; no noise rates, channel matrices, oracle values or source parameters
source_exposure_cost: each encoded trajectory uses5*T native carriers; all selection and validation trajectories charged; inherited frame acquisition is separate previously paid capital
elapsed_cost: each trajectory uses2*T+(T/r)*201 reference units, plus separately unpaid initial preparation/final readout interfaces
scope: simulated operational selection/holdout. Exact binomial decision certifies implemented record-law failure probability; translating to physical logical fidelity assumes trusted preparation/terminalreadout and numerical channel model. No certified diamond bound, hardware or positive quantumcapacity claim.
